items.description:
Struben Street Motors is a used-car dealership in Mayville, Pretoria, that has built its reputation over more than 35 years on professionalism, integrity, honesty and service excellence. The dealership stocks multiple marques, including Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, Ford and Volkswagen, with each car professionally inspected and tested before sale to give buyers peace of mind.

Its sales team is comprehensively trained in the industry and offers expert advice with what the dealership describes as a passion for great service, while in-house, speedy finance is made cost-effective through its multi-bank finance approval, alongside trade-ins and mechanical warranties. The dealership says its diversity of stock makes it possible to assist any client looking for a quality car. It suits buyers in Pretoria who want a used car from an established dealership, with finance, trade-in and warranty options handled on site.

SUM, short for Spectrum Utility Management, is a South African enterprise based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, with a history spanning 33 years. The company specialises in delivering locally crafted water and electricity solutions tailored for the utility and municipal sectors, pioneering the integration of utility management within local government through its own proprietary technology.

Its services include streetlight management, measuring consumption down to luminaire level with real-time, geo-located control, and electricity management covering the supply and distribution of both postpaid and prepaid electricity. The company's iSUM vending system handles electricity and water vending through STS meters, and it says its solutions help municipalities cut costs and improve data integrity. It suits municipalities and utilities in South Africa that need streetlight monitoring or electricity and water vending systems built and supported locally.

Summit Grill and Skybar Menlyn is a three-storey grill house and cocktail bar in the heart of Pretoria, on Garsfontein Road in Menlyn, built around sweeping rooftop views. The venue serves grill-house fare, pasta and sushi, alongside platters and drinks, and it positions itself as a supper club for guests who want a great vibe rather than a conventional sit-down restaurant.

Beyond regular dining, Summit hosts exclusive events and caters for private functions, with a pool deck and skybar adding to the rooftop setting. The venue encourages guests to follow it on Instagram and Facebook to keep up with upcoming events and entertainment lineups. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 10pm, Friday and Saturday from 8am to 2am, and Sunday from 8am to 11pm, and it suits diners in Menlyn looking for food, drinks, a view and a lively atmosphere in one venue.

SUPERSPAR Monument Park began in 1979 as a small grocer and has grown over four decades into one of the leading retailers in its industry, trading today from Monument Park Shopping Centre on Skilpad Road in Pretoria. The store carries more than 24,000 product lines, with in-house bakery, butchery and hot-food counters, fresh produce, sushi and floral departments, and its food menu covers custom cakes, large and small pizzas, platters and a dedicated sushi menu.

The supermarket credits an unwavering commitment to customer service as a key driver of its success, with every employee trained from the outset to put the customer first, an ethos its founders instilled from day one. As the business has grown, it says it has continued to invest heavily in staff training to maintain that same customer-centric approach. Open daily from 7am to 7:45pm, it suits Monument Park shoppers looking for a full-service supermarket with fresh food counters and extended daily hours.

Supply Chain Partner, trading as SCP, is a boutique procurement-solution implementation specialist based in Southdowns, Centurion, delivering what it calls peak procurement performance for clients across a wide range of industry sectors worldwide. Its work centres on Coupa implementations, spend management and cloud ERP integration, alongside change management and post-implementation training for organisations adopting new procurement systems.

The company was named Customer Success Partner of the Year for EMEA in 2026, reflecting its specialism in procurement transformation and in fixing underperforming Coupa systems for clients who are already live but not seeing results. Its client list includes names such as ABSA, Accor, Anglo American, Capitec, Exxaro, Honda, Glencore and McDonald's. It suits large organisations that need their procurement system implemented properly the first time, or fixed, integrated and supported after go-live.

items.description:
Swartboer Business Enterprises CC is a shuttle, logistics and construction company based in Silverton, Pretoria, that operates across all nine South African provinces and draws on more than 10 years of experience. Its team describes itself as experienced and qualified, ready to help with courier services for items that need to be transported in a timely and reliable manner.

The company also rents out vehicles by the day or longer depending on a client's needs, offers a dedicated fleet of mining trucks and buses for mining projects, and runs an e-hailing service where customers can request a driver. Alongside its transport services, the business also undertakes construction project work. It suits individuals and businesses across South Africa who need courier delivery, vehicle hire, mining transport or e-hailing handled by one established provider.

Swordfish Software, based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, is a debt collection and recovery software company it describes as the preferred provider of comprehensive debt collection solutions for businesses of all sizes. Its suite of products takes what it calls a cradle-to-grave approach to debt collection and recovery, with advanced functionality, integrations and compliance features built into the platform.

Beyond its core Swordfish platform, the company offers Goldfish, a quality assessment solution for call centres, Linkfish Middleware for automation, and Filefish Management Solution for workflow optimisation, giving clients tools to manage collections, quality and back-office processes together. Its client base includes major banks, law firms and collection agencies. It suits banks, law firms and collection agencies that want to elevate their debt collection, call centre quality and workflow management through one connected software suite.

items.description:
TALKR Communications, based in Mayville, Pretoria, is a two-way radio and business communications specialist offering VHF and UHF radios with advanced features such as geo-fencing and reporting. The company says it offers a comprehensive range of services built on leading technologies and products, with an emphasis on ongoing support for business communication needs.

Customer reviews collected on the company's own site, averaging 4.5 out of 5 from 33 reviews, describe efficient and pleasant service, friendly and excellent workmanship, and knowledgeable staff able to advise on the right radio setup, with some clients saying they have used the company for a number of years. The company also offers drone services, including drone flight reporting, alongside its core communications work. It suits businesses, estates and community groups in Pretoria that need reliable two-way radio systems with professional support behind them.

Tappo Industries is a Level 2 BBBEE-rated, South African owned manufacturer that has operated from the Automotive Supplier Park in Rosslyn since 2006. The company supplies paintshop and clean-room consumable products to the pharmaceutical industry and various OEM vehicle manufacturers and their allied suppliers across South Africa, under the strapline consistent quality since 2006.

Its product range includes lint-free and anti-static poly-cotton garments and caps made to order, imported high-quality tack cloths, lint-free sealer and solvent wipes, and custom-made lint-free robot covers. The company also specialises in material handling of automotive components for supply from Tier 1 suppliers to OEM line-side, and a separate track suit division supplies school tracksuits to outfitters across Gauteng and surrounding provinces. It suits pharmaceutical and automotive manufacturers that need cleanroom garments, wipes or protective covers made to order, as well as school outfitters needing tracksuits.

Tarps & Canvas Kings Projects, trading from Klerksoord in Akasia, supplies and installs custom-fitted canvas pool covers and awnings designed to enhance a customer's outdoor space. The company says its canvas awnings are built to withstand the elements, providing long-lasting protection and aesthetic appeal, while each pool cover is tailored to fit the customer's specific pool, helping with both safety and cleanliness.

Its pool covers are designed to reduce evaporation by up to 80% and inhibit algae growth, cutting down on water loss and pool maintenance over time. The company invites customers to reach out to its team to discuss their needs and receive a personalised quote before work begins. It is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm and Friday from 8am to 2pm, closed over weekends, and it suits homeowners in the Akasia area who want a pool cover or awning made to measure rather than bought off the shelf.

Team Support Labels CC, based near Parktown Estate in Mountain View, Pretoria, has worked in label manufacturing since 1999, producing digitally printed barcode, price and promotional labels for retail and logistics businesses. The company says its experienced, committed and skilful staff help customers every step of the way, from design through to production, so that labelling requirements are met without the client having to manage the process themselves.

Its digital printing offers high-quality print, short runs and a shorter lead time than traditional methods, with labels supplied on a roll, suitable for overprinting, able to be produced on all types of label material, and available laminated or UV treated. The company also supplies barcode printers designed to meet the needs of businesses across a variety of industries. It suits retail and logistics businesses in Pretoria that need custom labels or barcode printing equipment supplied locally.

Technosgn is a 100% Black-owned IT consulting company based in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, led by an experienced IT professional certified across multiple technology platforms. The company's mission is to empower, upskill and create jobs, working from the belief that its success is tied to the country's success, and it partners with AWS, Microsoft and Pinnacle.

Its managed support services include 24/7 IT support infrastructure, Microsoft product support, network installation and services, cloud backup, software and hardware sales, computer repair and backup solutions. On the development side, it offers website development, mobile app development, maintenance and backup, hosting and domain services, and design work covering logos, banners, business cards and social media posts. Client feedback on its site describes a great overall experience and consistent service delivery on repeat orders. It suits small and medium businesses in Centurion that want IT support and digital development services handled by one black-owned technology partner.

Tesk & Amandla Pumps, based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, is a wholesale supplier of pumps and accessories for moving liquid across agriculture, industrial, fire safety, civil, manufacturing, domestic and mining applications. Its submersible pump range covers 4-inch pumps in both Johntech and Tesk lines, along with 6, 7, 8 and 10-inch submersible pumps, matching submersible motors from 4 to 10 inches, and surface pumps including SMD monobloc, vertical multistage, TK inline circulation, end suction and intelligent PMC pumps.

The company also supplies sewage pumps and pump packs, along with accessories such as control boxes and switches, surface kits, base plates, cable joints, submersible cable, safety rope, column pipe, casings and pipe thread converters. Tesk SA and Amandla Pumps Manufacturing exhibited their pump range at Electra Mining Africa 2024, showcasing their solutions to the wider mining and industrial sector. It suits farms, mines, municipalities and industrial sites across South Africa that need borehole, surface or sewage pumps and the accessories to install them.

Tevo Factory Outlet, based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, trades as part of Tevo, a South African business that sources, develops, markets and distributes innovative, high-quality products. The outlet's ranges cover outdoor products, backup power solutions, electronics, toys, health and beauty, and household goods, including the Bennett Read line, with nationwide delivery and an extended warranty programme.

Tevo describes itself as built on a foundation of continual innovation, working with leading developers and suppliers worldwide so that each product brings a new trend or makes customers' lives easier rather than following convention. The company says it is fanatical about quality, subjecting every product to rigorous in-house research and development testing, with prototypes and final production samples distributed to independent testers before launch. It suits shoppers in Kosmosdal and across South Africa looking for innovative outdoor, electronics or household products backed by nationwide delivery and warranty support.

The Company Buddy, based at Zayit House in Irene, Pretoria, handles corporate compliance and company-secretarial work, including forming new companies, CIPC filings, submitting annual returns and Beneficial Ownership filings, and managing director changes, share capital and MOI amendments for company directors. The firm is led by an admitted attorney of the High Court of South Africa, holding a Bachelor of Commerce in Law and an LLB, who has advised more than 800 corporate clients across the country.

The firm was founded on the view that essential compliance services are too often overcomplicated or overpriced by traditional providers, and it aims to bridge the gap between cost-effective solutions and professional-quality service. Its guidance is described as practical and straightforward, whether a business is just starting out or already established. It suits company directors and business owners in Pretoria who want governance, compliance and company-secretarial work handled without the usual cost or complexity.

The Family Dentist is a dental practice on Rhode Street in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, categorised as a dentist, dental clinic, emergency dental service and paediatric dentist. Its services cover general dentistry, dental emergencies, paediatric dentistry and tooth reconstructions, supported by online booking, free short-distance Uber rides for patients and secured on-site parking.

Online reviews describe friendly, empathetic staff who help put nervous patients at ease, along with excellent, efficient service during visits. The practice is open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 8pm, Friday from 9am to 3pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, giving patients early-morning and evening appointment options during the week. It suits families in Faerie Glen who want a dentist offering both routine care and emergency treatment, with convenient transport and parking included.

The Food Works Hennopspark is a family business founded in 2019 that makes restaurant-quality frozen meals for busy families, sold from its two shops in Hennopspark and Moreleta. Customers can walk into a shop and choose from the freezers, or fill in an order form and send it through for delivery across Centurion and Pretoria East for a R40 fee.

Among its top-selling dishes are beef burritos, cottage pie and chicken a la king, sold in two- or four-portion sizes to suit different household sizes, alongside other chicken dishes, rice-based meals, pies, desserts and pre-cooked vegetables. The company's tagline, where the food's even better than the prices, reflects its focus on satisfying people's hunger for simple pleasures at an accessible cost. It suits busy households in Centurion and Pretoria East who want home-style frozen meals delivered or collected in person.

items.description:
The Hearing Clinic (Pretoria), based at Avocet Corner in Hazeldean Office Park, offers hearing tests, virtual consultations, earwax removal, referral to medical specialists, hearing aid maintenance and repairs, custom hearing protection and tinnitus treatment. Patients can choose from 10 of the world's leading hearing aid brands, with styles including behind-the-ear, in-the-ear, in-the-canal and completely-in-the-canal devices.

The clinic offers a free, guided hearing aid trial tailored to each patient's needs, aiming for a seamless fit and optimal functionality before any purchase decision is made. Its approach is built around the idea that better hearing helps people connect more easily with those around them, stay included in everyday moments, and support healthier brain function as they age. It is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 4pm, and it suits Pretoria patients who feel overwhelmed by the range of hearing aid options and want guided support to find the right one.

The Rock-Hazelwood, trading from Shop 113 at The Club Retail Centre on Pinaster Avenue, is a fine-dining restaurant with an inviting ambiance and interior design, part of a small group of Rock branches that also includes Design Quarter, Kyalami and Carnelian. The restaurant's menu features succulent ribs and chicken wings, fresh oysters, and seafood pasta with perfectly cooked seafood, along with a chicken liver starter the restaurant calls a must-try.

Its bar serves signature cocktails, including the citrus-forward Excalibur, alongside a wide range of soft drinks and wines, while dessert options include a crème brûlée with thyme and a lemon meringue pie. The restaurant offers outdoor seating and live music, and its reasonable price range is pitched to make fine dining accessible rather than exclusive. Open Monday to Saturday from 8am to 10pm and Sunday from 8am to 9pm, it suits diners in Hazelwood looking for a relaxed, upscale meal with a lively atmosphere.

The Sox Factory, based in Roodeplaat, Pretoria, is a global custom sock manufacturer that creates premium personalised socks, arm sleeves and sweatbands for brands, teams and events. The company makes its products in South Africa with a low minimum order of 30 pairs and a fast turnaround of one to two weeks, offering a range of sock styles including premium crew socks engineered for versatility and comfort, ribbed crew socks with a distinctive texture and relaxed fit, and casual crew socks designed for high-quantity promotional gifting with a one-size-fits-most, low-profile seamed toe.

Production runs under ISO 9001 and OEKO-TEX certification, with in-house design support and the option to become a reseller of the brand's socks. Visits to the Roodeplaat facility are by appointment only, with office hours Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm. It suits sports teams, corporate brands and event organisers who want custom branded socks made quickly and in relatively small quantities.

Theron's Meat Products is a well-established, family-run meat processing business in Pretoria West that has manufactured value-added meat products for the wholesale and retail industry since 1983. The company is known for a wide variety of sausages, including its popular Boerewors, Russians, Chicken Viennas, Cheese Grillers, Frankfurters and Bockwurst, alongside bacon, hams and other smoked meats.

The business is one of the few processed meat factories that still uses the traditional wood-smoke method, which it says gives its products extra flavour and extends their shelf life, produced in a limited number of meat processing plants with sought-after accreditation. Its factory shop in Pretoria West sells directly to the public at wholesale prices, positioning the business as the place to go for price-conscious consumers. The shop is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, and it suits households and businesses who want traditionally smoked meat products at factory prices.

Thoka Properties is a real estate service provider established in 2018 by a group of experienced professionals with a wealth of knowledge in the industry, based at Corobay Corner in Menlyn, Pretoria. The agency's listings cover residential property for sale and to let, new developments, commercial and industrial property for sale or to let, retail and mixed-use property, agricultural land, farms and smallholdings, vacant land, and holiday letting, giving it a wide spread across South Africa's property types.

Its strapline, experience excellence through ethical innovation, reflects a foundation the agency describes as built on unwavering ethical principles. Buyers and sellers can use its area profiles, calculators, property email alerts and agent search tools, or list a property directly through the site. It suits buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords across South Africa looking for an agency handling everything from residential homes to farms and vacant land.

items.description:
TMA Express Road is part of the TMA Group, a provider of cost-effective express transport services based at Samrand Business Park in Centurion, with 30 years of logistics experience since 1994. The group operates through four divisions: TMA Express Road for cross-border express cargo, TMA Logistics, TMA Clearing for customs clearing and buying-house services, and TMA Africa, giving it a specific technical and operational knowledge of running a large trucking enterprise across South Africa and other African countries.

Its cross-border express service links South Africa with Zimbabwe and Zambia, while the group also serves the FMCG and select retail sector with rapid transport for fast-moving consumer goods, manufacturing with reliable delivery of raw materials and finished products, pharmaceuticals with secure, time-sensitive shipments, automotive and machinery with parts and equipment transport, and mining and engineering with logistics for heavy equipment and supplies. The group's stated mission is to do whatever it takes to ensure client satisfaction. It suits businesses needing reliable cross-border freight between South Africa, Zimbabwe and Zambia, or sector-specific logistics across Southern Africa.

items.description:
TrenStar SA, based at Highveld Techno Park in Centurion, is the South African head office of TrenStar, a provider of returnable rental packaging for supply chains. The company supplies standard and specialised returnable packaging along with supply chain and agricultural solutions, aiming to optimise process efficiency for industries globally by offering visibility, collaboration, control and efficiency.

Its services combine returnable packaging, enabling technology and support so that clients can track uniquely identifiable assets for traceability, reduce manual intervention, decrease inventory levels, and manage itemised invoicing and unique item stock takes. The company says its strategy is to proactively seek out the expressed and unexpressed process efficiency needs of any industry, providing scalable, adaptable and cost-effective solutions. It suits supply chain operators who want pooled, trackable returnable packaging rather than single-use packaging managed in-house.

Tshukudu Survey's, based at Montana Estate in Doornpoort, Pretoria, is a land surveying, engineering and topographical surveying firm that uses the latest survey equipment and software to provide a fast, cost-effective service both within and beyond South Africa's borders. The company offers topographical, engineering, construction and mining surveys, power line and pipeline staking, and Lidar surveys.

The firm says it strives to use the latest survey equipment and technology, keeping its surveyors trained and up to date so that surveys stay accurate, reliable and cost-effective, giving it an edge over competitors. Beyond its Gauteng base, the company operates from additional offices in Limpopo and Mpumalanga, and it also rents and sells survey equipment and plant to other users. It suits mining, construction and infrastructure clients across Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, North West and the Northern Cape who need accurate land or engineering surveys carried out.

Tshwane School for Business and Society (TSB), based on Nana Sita Street in Pretoria Central, is an accredited business school uniquely placed in the capital of South Africa, leading the way for business and government leaders and managers to develop and sustain integrated organic and social growth. It offers the PDBA, MBA and DBA degrees, alongside 13 executive development programmes covering leadership, management, entrepreneurship, agribusiness and innovation.

The school is accredited by the South African Council on Higher Education, and its MBA programme is one of only two in South Africa where the research component is structured as MBA Projects, helping more than 80% of students complete the degree within the minimum two years. The MBA is available to potential leaders and managers in Gauteng, Mbombela and Polokwane who want to make a difference. It suits working professionals in these regions who want a locally accredited postgraduate business qualification or a shorter executive development programme.

TTS-Top Talent Solutions, based in Monument Park, Pretoria, helps organisations make better talent decisions through highly contextualised, flexible and integrated assessment processes. The company delivers online talent solutions by integrating the science of industrial psychology, technology and a choice of best-of-breed assessment and development products, tailoring each solution to the organisation it serves.

Its expertise, products and technology support decisions whether a client is assessing one individual or thousands, covering screening, selection, development or succession planning through its talent assessment technologies and expert services. The company also runs training and events, including conferences, and publishes resources such as articles, webinars and white papers for clients to draw on. It suits organisations in Pretoria and beyond that want psychometric assessment and talent decision support built around their own specific needs rather than a one-size-fits-all test.

Turaco Business Logix, based on King Street in Irene, Centurion, provides rapidly implementable operational intelligence solutions for asset and fleet management, suitable for industries including mining, fleet logistics, power grid management, security, supply chain visibility and industrial monitoring. Its platform incorporates GSM, WiFi, RFID, satellite, Sigfox, LoRa, NB-IoT, BLE and GNSS communication and positioning technologies to track assets in real time.

The company says its solutions give businesses valuable insights and data analytics into their operational activities, helping to improve productivity, identify and eliminate unnecessary costs, improve service delivery, strengthen security and safety, reduce risks and increase profit margins. Its device-independent, cloud-based management platform is described as mature, secure and scalable, and can be customised to suit almost any client's needs. It suits mining, construction, coal and passenger-vehicle fleet operators who want real-time visibility over their assets rather than relying on manual tracking.

Unique Metal Works CC, based on Caledon Street in Daspoort, Pretoria, is a metal fabrication business with an extensive product catalogue organised by category on its own site. Its decorative ironwork ranges include rosettes, scrolls, spears and leaves, alongside bars, collars and panels, giving customers a wide choice of forged and cast decorative components for gates, fencing and ironwork projects.

The company also produces structural components and industrial castings and forgings, covering both decorative and functional metalwork from one supplier. Customers can browse the company's product categories directly, with each range given its own dedicated section on the business's website. It suits fabricators, contractors and property owners in Pretoria who need decorative ironwork components or industrial castings and forgings sourced from a specialist metal works.

items.description:
Van Aswegen Attorney, trading as LVA Attorneys from West Street in Pretoria North, offers expert legal solutions built on 20 years of experience. The firm's practice areas span Magistrate and High Court litigation, family law, divorces, civil litigation, debt collection, insolvencies, commercial contracts, and wills and administration of deceased estates.

The firm describes itself as committed to helping clients succeed, positioning its combination of litigation and transactional practice areas as a single point of contact for both contentious disputes and everyday legal and estate planning needs. It suits individuals and businesses in Pretoria North who need an experienced attorney for anything from a divorce or deceased estate to debt collection or a commercial contract.

Van der Walt & Hugo Inc, based on Willem Botha Drive in Eldoraigne, Centurion, is a commercial law firm and conveyancing specialist offering a full spectrum of legal services to individual and corporate clients. Its work is structured into two main divisions: Conveyancing and Bonds, and Litigation and Dispute Resolution, each supported by experienced professionals focused on efficient, practical and results-driven solutions.

Through an established network of associates and correspondents, the firm says it can respond quickly and effectively to client needs across South Africa, rather than being limited to its own office. Its stated vision is to grow as a trusted and progressive law firm that truly understands its clients' needs, delivering legal services with what it describes as a personal touch. It suits individuals and businesses in Centurion handling a property transfer, bond registration, or a litigation or dispute resolution matter.

Van Zyl Incorporated Attorneys / Properties, founded in 1998 and based on Jean Avenue in Doringkloof, Centurion, specialises in conveyancing, commercial law, estate planning, litigation and other legal services across Pretoria and Johannesburg. Its practice areas also include property law, family law and notarial services, drawing on more than 50 years of combined legal experience across its team of directors.

The firm says it strives towards the highest level of professionalism while aiming to offer dynamic, client-focused legal services built on developing technological innovation and consistency, which it credits for a solid and dependable reputation in the legal community. Its stated mission is not only to understand clients and their needs, but to build lasting relationships with them through professionalism and reliable service. It suits individuals and businesses in Centurion and the greater Gauteng area who need conveyancing, estate planning, commercial law or litigation handled by an established firm.

Vaporiz - Vapelounge, trading from Shop 14 at Wierda 2 Shopping Centre in Wierdapark, Centurion, is a vaporizer store known for its vapes and accessories, holding a 4.6-star rating from more than 160 reviews on at least one vape store directory. The shop stocks a range of local e-liquid flavours and vaping hardware, and its lounge area gives customers free Wi-Fi and a place to sit while they shop or try a new flavour.

The store keeps regular daily hours, open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 4pm, and Sunday from 9am to 2pm, giving shoppers a consistent schedule across the week. It suits vapers in Wierdapark and Centurion who want to browse e-liquids and hardware in person, with a lounge area to relax in rather than just a quick transaction.

Variable, based On the Lake in Centurion Central, is an IT services and managed-technology company offering hosting solutions, cloud backup solutions, social media services, managed IT services, remote support through AnyDesk, and web application development. The company describes its goal as going the extra mile to become its clients' long-term, trusted technology partner.

Its stated vision is to be flexible and perform tasks for customers with passion, while its mission is to generate exceptional value and continually increase the service it provides. The company positions itself as handling both today's professional IT needs and a client's growing business needs tomorrow, rather than offering a single once-off service. It is open Monday to Friday from 7am to 4pm, and it suits businesses that want hosting, backup, managed IT and web development support from a single long-term partner.

Venture Graphix, based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, has been a truck branding specialist in Gauteng since 1991, turning trucks, vans and business fleets into what it calls professional moving billboards. Services include custom vinyl wraps and truck, van and fleet branding produced in-house, covering digital printing, lamination and vinyl-cutting, followed by on-site installation at the client's own premises rather than requiring vehicles to be dropped off elsewhere.

The business is run by a sign-writer who graduated from the Pretoria Technicon Art School with a National Diploma in Graphic Design before entering the sign and design industry in 1991, and who built a childhood passion for making stickers into a long career in vehicle branding. The company emphasises strong, durable, road-ready branding that stands out on every trip, without the weak designs or substandard vinyl that flakes and fades before the next service. It suits fleet owners in Gauteng who want vehicle branding installed on-site rather than at a workshop.

Veritas Rekenmeesters is an accounting and taxation firm based on Jean Avenue in Doringkloof, Centurion, servicing small and medium businesses as well as individuals. Its services cover income tax for individuals, companies, close corporations and trusts, accounting services, secretarial work such as company registration updates, and training.

The firm describes its team as trustworthy and experienced, with trusted accounting professionals delivering reliable financial services with integrity and accuracy, backed by a seasoned team with extensive experience in accounting, taxation and financial advisory. It says it specialises in solving complex financial matters through meticulous attention to detail, ethical practices and a client-centred approach. It suits sole proprietors, companies, trusts and individuals in Centurion who want their tax compliance, bookkeeping and corporate secretarial work handled by one firm.

items.description:
Waterkloof Corner Pharmacy, trading from Waterkloof Corner Shopping Centre on the corner of Crown and Main Street, is part of the Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group. Its page carries the group's pledge of putting the customer's family first as its pharmacist's commitment, alongside family clinic and warehousing services offered through the group.

The pharmacy combines in-store and off-site delivery with clinic-backed health advice, and it keeps extended hours, open Monday to Friday from 7am to 7pm and Saturday and Sunday from 8am to 7pm, giving customers a pharmacy to rely on outside standard weekday hours. It suits Waterkloof families who want a neighbourhood pharmacy backed by a wider group's clinic and delivery services.

WebDevine, based on Braam Pretorius Street in Pretoria, is a web design company that has helped South African businesses grow online since 2003, with a second office in Cape Town. Its services include custom website design and development, website maintenance and redesign, quarterly, semi-annual and annual maintenance plans, e-commerce and admin facilities, website landing pages, Google Ads and SEO, social media management, branding, and web hosting with SSL certificates.

The company holds 110 Google reviews with an average rating of 4.9 out of 5, and it describes its approach as pairing strategy-led design with targeted performance marketing and secure infrastructure so that a client's website ranks higher, attracts quality leads and grows sustainably. It suits South African businesses across Gauteng, Cape Town and nationwide that want a website built, maintained and marketed by one team rather than several separate providers.

Well Health Pro, also trading as Cilliers & Swart Physiotherapists, is a physiotherapy practice group operating since 2011 with sites in Garsfontein and Lynnwood, Pretoria. Its team tests joints, muscles, nerves, ligaments, tendons and bone to diagnose an injury or source of pain, explains the findings and how severe the problem is, and guides patients through a treatment programme built to accelerate tissue healing without surgery.
